title: Identification of Potential Sex-Specific Biomarkers in Pigs with Low and High Intramuscular Fat Content Using Integrated Bioinformatics and Machine Learning.
authors: Yang, Yongli; Wang, Xiaoyi; Wang, Shuyan; Chen, Qiang; Li, Mingli; Lu, Shaoxiong
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用生物信息学和机器学习鉴定猪肌内脂肪含量的性别特异性生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子-生物标志物网络预测，但核心是表达谱分析与标志物筛选，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Intramuscular fat (IMF) content is a key determinant of pork quality. Controlling the genetic and physiological factors of IMF and the expression patterns of various genes is important for regulating the IMF content and improving meat quality in pig breeding. Growing evidence has suggested the role of genetic factors and breeds in IMF deposition; however, research on the sex factors of IMF deposition is still lacking. The present study aimed to identify potential sex-specific biomarkers strongly associated with IMF deposition in low- and high-IMF pig populations. The GSE144780 expression dataset of IMF deposition-related genes were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus. Initially, differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were detected in male and female low-IMF (162 DEGs, including 64 up- and 98 down-regulated genes) and high-IMF pigs (202 DEGs, including 147 up- and 55 down-regulated genes). Moreover, hub genes were screened via PPI network construction. Furthermore, hub genes were screened for potential sex-specific biomarkers using the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator machine learning algorithm, and sex-specific biomarkers in low-IMF (troponin I (TNNI1), myosin light chain 9(MYL9), and serpin family C member 1(SERPINC1)) and high-IMF pigs (CD4 molecule (CD4), CD2 molecule (CD2), and amine oxidase copper-containing 2(AOC2)) were identified, and then verified by quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) in semimembranosus muscles. Additionally, the gene set enrichment analysis and single-sample gene set enrichment analysis of hallmark gene sets were collectively performed on the identified biomarkers. Finally, the transcription factor-biomarker and lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA (biomarker) networks were predicted. The identified potential sex-specific biomarkers may provide new insights into the molecular mechanisms of IMF deposition and the beneficial foundation for improving meat quality in pig breeding.
abstract_zh: 肌内脂肪（IMF）含量是猪肉品质的关键决定因素。控制IMF的遗传和生理因素及各种基因的表达模式，对于调控IMF含量和改善猪育种中的肉质具有重要意义。越来越多的证据表明遗传因素和品种在IMF沉积中的作用；然而，关于IMF沉积的性别因素研究仍显不足。本研究旨在识别与低和高IMF猪群体中IMF沉积密切相关的潜在性别特异性生物标志物。从Gene Expression Omnibus获取了IMF沉积相关基因的GSE144780表达数据集。首先，在雄性和雌性低IMF猪（162个差异表达基因（DEGs），包括64个上调和98个下调基因）和高IMF猪（202个DEGs，包括147个上调和55个下调基因）中检测到差异表达基因。此外，通过PPI网络构建筛选出核心基因。进一步，利用最小绝对收缩和选择算子机器学习算法筛选核心基因中的潜在性别特异性生物标志物，并在低IMF猪（肌钙蛋白I（TNNI1）、肌球蛋白轻链9（MYL9）和丝氨酸蛋白酶抑制剂家族C成员1（SERPINC1））和高IMF猪（CD4分子（CD4）、CD2分子（CD2）和含铜胺氧化酶2（AOC2））中识别出性别特异性生物标志物，随后通过定量实时PCR（qRT-PCR）在半膜肌中验证。此外，对识别出的生物标志物进行了标志性基因集的基因集富集分析和单样本基因集富集分析。最后，预测了转录因子-生物标志物和lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA（生物标志物）网络。识别出的潜在性别特异性生物标志物可能为IMF沉积的分子机制提供新见解，并为改善猪育种中的肉质奠定有益基础。
